title: LLM Agents for Automated Web Vulnerability Reproduction: Are We There Yet?
evidence_excerpt: we present the first comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLM agents... we select three top-performing agents... for in-depth evaluation on our constructed benchmark dataset of 80 real-world CVEs.
rationale: Benchmarks: own 80-CVE benchmark with 16 dimensions.

title: Between Promise and Pain: The Reality of Automating Failure Analysis in Microservices with LLMs
evidence_excerpt: We systematically evaluate multiple LLM agent architectures across a range of incident scenarios... Lastly, we preliminary curate a benchmark of Q&A to assess the ability of LLMs to retrieve and reason on artifacts of microservices applications.
rationale: Benchmarks: own incident scenarios and Q&A benchmark.

title: Process-Centric Analysis of Agentic Software Systems
evidence_excerpt: We also implement a novel technique for real-time construction and analysis of Graphectory and Langutory during the agent's execution to flag trajectory issues. Upon detecting such issues in the trajectory, the proposed technique notifies the agent with a diagnostic message and, when applicable, rolls back the trajectory.
rationale: Benchmarks (own large-scale trajectory evaluation) and Runtime Monitors (online intervention and rollback). Secondary: safety.

title: Sari Sandbox: A Virtual Retail Store Environment for Embodied AI Agents
evidence_excerpt: We also introduce SariBench, a dataset of annotated human demonstrations across varied task difficulties. Our sandbox enables embodied agents to navigate, inspect, and manipulate retail items, providing baselines against human performance.
rationale: Benchmarks: own SariBench against human baselines.

title: CubeBench: Diagnosing Interactive, Long-Horizon Spatial Reasoning Under Partial Observations
evidence_excerpt: we introduce CubeBench, a novel generative benchmark centered on the Rubik's Cube. CubeBench uses a three-tiered diagnostic framework that progressively assesses agent capabilities...
rationale: Benchmarks: own generative diagnostic benchmark.

title: Can LLM Agents Generate Real-World Evidence? Evaluating Observational Studies in Medical Databases
evidence_excerpt: we introduce RWE-bench, a benchmark grounded in MIMIC-IV and derived from peer-reviewed observational studies... We evaluate six LLMs... under three agent scaffolds using both question-level correctness and end-to-end task metrics.
rationale: Benchmarks: own RWE-bench; the regulatory framing is context only.

title: SEC-bench: Automated Benchmarking of LLM Agents on Real-World Software Security Tasks
evidence_excerpt: We introduce SEC-bench, the first fully automated benchmarking framework for evaluating LLM agents on authentic security engineering tasks... a comprehensive evaluation of state-of-the-art LLM code agents reveals significant performance gaps.
rationale: Benchmarks: automated benchmark construction; sanitizer checks are an evaluation oracle, not a runtime monitor.

title: OfficeBench: Benchmarking Language Agents across Multiple Applications for Office Automation
evidence_excerpt: We introduce OFFICEBENCH, one of the first office automation benchmarks for evaluating current LLM agents' capability to address the office tasks in realistic office workflows... Applying our customized evaluation methods on each task, we find that GPT-4 Omni achieves the highest pass rate of 47.00%.
rationale: Benchmarks: own benchmark with exact, fuzzy and execution-based evaluation.

title: IDA-Bench: Evaluating LLMs on Interactive Guided Data Analysis
evidence_excerpt: we introduce IDA-Bench, a novel benchmark evaluating LLM agents in multi-round interactive scenarios... Agent performance is judged by comparing its final numerical output to the human-derived baseline.
rationale: Benchmarks: own interactive benchmark against human baselines.

title: GameBench: Evaluating Strategic Reasoning Abilities of LLM Agents
evidence_excerpt: GAMEBENCH, a cross-domain benchmark for evaluating strategic reasoning abilities of LLM agents... We focus on 9 different game environments... Agents are rated using the exponential Bradley-Terry model
rationale: Benchmarks: own multi-game suite and rating protocol. Secondary: inherently multi-agent games.

title: Exploring LLM-Based Agents for Root Cause Analysis
evidence_excerpt: we present a thorough empirical evaluation of a ReAct agent equipped with retrieval tools, on an out-of-distribution dataset of production incidents collected at Microsoft... we also conduct a qualitative coding on a sample of 100 predictions
rationale: Benchmarks: own evaluation setup for root-cause analysis.

title: AssistantBench: Can Web Agents Solve Realistic and Time-Consuming Tasks?
evidence_excerpt: We introduce ASSISTANTBENCH, a challenging new benchmark consisting of 214 realistic tasks that can be automatically evaluated... we propose SPA, a web agent equipped with memory and planning components
rationale: Benchmarks: own 214-task benchmark.

title: LiveTradeBench: Seeking Real-World Alpha with Large Language Models
evidence_excerpt: we introduce LiveTradeBench, a live trading environment for evaluating LLM agents in realistic and evolving markets... we run 50-day live evaluations of 21 LLMs across families
rationale: Benchmarks: own live-market environment; financial markets are not CPS.

title: TextQuests: How Good are LLMs at Text-Based Video Games?
evidence_excerpt: we introduce TEXTQUESTS, a benchmark based on the Infocom suite of interactive fiction games... we introduce a new Game Progress metric based on labeled checkpoints
rationale: Benchmarks: own 25-game suite with new metrics.

title: Beyond Task Completion: Revealing Corrupt Success in LLM Agents through Procedure-Aware Evaluation
evidence_excerpt: 27-78% of benchmark reported successes are corrupt successes concealing violations across interaction and integrity... Procedural Integrity measures whether the agent followed mandatory constraints throughout task execution
rationale: Benchmarks: own procedure-aware protocol on tau-bench. Secondary: policy violations (safety).

title: Agent-Testing Agent: A Meta-Agent for Automated Testing and Evaluation of Conversational AI Agents
evidence_excerpt: We present the Agent-Testing Agent (ATA)... Each dialogue is scored with an LLM-as-a-Judge (LAAJ) rubric and used to steer subsequent tests toward the agent's weakest capabilities... the ATA surfaces more diverse and severe failures than expert annotators
rationale: Benchmarks: own adaptive adversarial testing validated against annotators.

title: Orak: A Foundational Benchmark for Training and Evaluating LLM Agents on Diverse Video Games
evidence_excerpt: we present Orak, a benchmark for training and evaluating LLM agents across 12 popular video games... Orak offers a united evaluation framework, including game leaderboards, LLM battle arenas, and in-depth analyses of input modality, agentic strategies, and fine-tuning effects
rationale: Benchmarks: own multi-game benchmark. Secondary: head-to-head battle arena (multi-agent).

title: FedAgentBench: Towards Automating Real-world Federated Medical Image Analysis with Server-Client LLM Agents
evidence_excerpt: we introduce a benchmark dubbed FedAgentBench that evaluates the ability of LLM agents to autonomously coordinate healthcare FL... The server-client agent system A = {S1, S2, S3, S4, C1, C2, C3} comprises 7 role-specialized LLM agents
rationale: Benchmarks: own FL benchmark. Secondary: server-client coordination failures (multi-agent).

title: Both Ends Count! Just How Good are LLM Agents at "Text-to-Big SQL"?
evidence_excerpt: we propose a benchmarking methodology for text-to-Big SQL agents... we propose the novel text-to-Big SQL metric called VES*... We also introduce the Valid Cost-Efficiency Score (VCES)
rationale: Benchmarks: own metrics for Big-Data SQL agents.

title: Assessing generalizability of Deep Reinforcement Learning algorithms for Automated Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing
evidence_excerpt: We define a novel VAPT environment involving a general state space... we devise four evaluation scenarios characterized by different levels of overlap between training and testing sets... to evaluate VAPT operations based on one shallow RL algorithm and three DRL algorithms
rationale: Benchmarks: own environment and scenarios for DRL generalization.

title: Evaluating Agentic Optimization on Large Codebases
evidence_excerpt: We introduce FORMULACODE, a benchmark for evaluating agentic optimization on large, real-world codebases with fine-grained, multi-objective performance metrics... comprises 957 performance bottlenecks mined from scientific Python repositories
rationale: Benchmarks: own FormulaCode suite.

title: Automatic Generation of Scenarios for System-level Simulation-based Verification of Autonomous Driving Systems
evidence_excerpt: VIVAS is a V&V framework for generating test cases for autonomous systems... instantiated by the concretization of the abstract parameters to provide concrete scenarios to be executed on a system-level simulator encompassing AI/ML models, to obtain execution traces... analyzed by an automatically-generated monitor
rationale: CPS Validation: closed-loop V&V of ADS in CARLA. Secondary: collision avoidance (safety).

title: LLM Agents for Generating Microservice-based Applications: how complex is your specification?
evidence_excerpt: we created 8 MSes across 2 MSBAs... We wrote unit test cases based upon the spec and used them to test the GT solution... developed a REST API testing framework... to evaluate LLM Agents on MSBAs
rationale: Benchmarks: own specifications, implementations and tests.

title: InfoDeepSeek: Benchmarking Agentic Information Seeking for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
evidence_excerpt: we present InfoDeepSeek, a new benchmark with challenging questions designed for assessing agentic information seeking in real-world, dynamic web environments... we develop the first evaluation framework tailored to dynamic agentic information seeking, including fine-grained metrics
rationale: Benchmarks: own dataset and metrics for agentic information seeking.

title: Plancraft: an evaluation dataset for planning with LLM agents
evidence_excerpt: We present Plancraft, a multi-modal evaluation dataset for LLM agents... Plancraft also includes a subset of examples that are intentionally unsolvable... We benchmark both open-source and closed-source LLMs and compare their performance and efficiency to a handcrafted planner
rationale: Benchmarks: own dataset with a handcrafted planner baseline.

title: Continuous Benchmark Generation for Evaluating Enterprise-scale LLM Agents
evidence_excerpt: we introduce a continuous benchmark generation pipeline that evolves alongside changing requirements... enabling longitudinal, adaptive evaluation of enterprise-scale agents as both the agents and the underlying platforms evolve
rationale: Benchmarks (benchmark-generation protocol) and MLOps/Drift (adapting evaluation to platform drift). Secondary: behavioral.

title: AD-Bench: A Real-World, Trajectory-Aware Advertising Analytics Benchmark for LLM Agents
evidence_excerpt: Dynamic Ground-Truth Generation Pipeline. To mitigate ground-truth obsolescence... we record their problem-solving trajectories and associated tool calls. During evaluation, we replay these trajectories and re-execute the corresponding tool calls to regenerate ground-truth answers consistent with the current environment
rationale: Benchmarks: own trajectory-aware benchmark. Secondary: re-execution against obsolete ground truth (temporal).

title: UltraHorizon: Benchmarking Agent Capabilities in Ultra Long-Horizon Scenarios
evidence_excerpt: we introduce UltraHorizon, a novel benchmark that measures the foundational capabilities essential for complex real-world challenges... Agents are designed in long-horizon discovery tasks where they must iteratively uncover hidden rules
rationale: Benchmarks: three custom exploration environments with LLM-judge scoring.

title: AI-Trader: Benchmarking Autonomous Agents in Real-Time Financial Markets
evidence_excerpt: we introduce AI-Trader, the first fully-automated, live, and data-uncontaminated evaluation benchmark for LLM agents in financial decision-making... We evaluate six mainstream LLMs across three markets and multiple trading frequencies
rationale: Benchmarks: own live multi-market benchmark.

title: ZT-ICAS: A Zero-Trust Integrity-Constrained Framework for Agentic Vulnerability Scanning
evidence_excerpt: Four deterministic security layers (Input Guard, State Guard, Action Guard, Integrity Guard) intercept both input attacks and output risks... Action Guard intercepts each tool invocation request and authenticates the request using a very rigid Allow-List... causing an immediate circuit breaker and end the session.
rationale: Runtime Monitors: layered guard blocks injection, tool abuse and context poisoning.

title: Taxonomy, Evaluation and Exploitation of IPI-Centric LLM Agent Defense Frameworks
evidence_excerpt: We conduct a thorough evaluation of representative frameworks on three major existing agent IPI benchmarks... standardize the configurations across all benchmarks and defense frameworks... we design three novel adaptive attacks that significantly improve attack success rates targeting specific frameworks.
rationale: Benchmarks (own cross-benchmark protocol) and Runtime Monitors (analysis of enforcing defenses). Secondary: utility (behavioral).

title: Nuclear Deployed: Analyzing Catastrophic Risks in Decision-making of Autonomous LLM Agents
evidence_excerpt: We meticulously design a 3-stage evaluation framework with agentic rollouts... We conduct a total of 14,400 rollouts across 12 state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs... We report the Risk Rate... and the Deception Rate.
rationale: Benchmarks: own simulation protocol with risk and deception rates. Secondary: behavioral.

title: CRALA: A Chinese-centric Risk Simulation and Assessment Framework for LLM Agents
evidence_excerpt: We created a diverse dataset of 100 high-risk usage cases based on 55 popular Chinese apps... The careful evaluation of 6 LLMs shows that significant safety deficiencies exist... Even the most advanced GPT-4 model has a safety rate of only 35%.
rationale: Benchmarks: own framework with human-validated scoring. Secondary: task completion (behavioral).

title: Conformal Predictive Monitoring for Multi-Modal Scenarios
evidence_excerpt: Predictive monitoring is an advanced form of runtime verification that leverages forecasts of a system's future behavior to detect safety violations before they occur... GenQPM, a method that leverages deep generative models... to reliably approximate the probabilistic and multi-modal system dynamics.
rationale: Runtime Monitors: real-time predictive monitor with calibrated guarantees; simulations are evaluation only.

title: ComOpT: Combination and Optimization for Testing Autonomous Driving Systems
evidence_excerpt: We use ComOpT to test the Apollo 6 autonomous driving software stack... ComOpT evaluates each concrete scenario against a set of KPIs... discovered numerous undesired scenarios... including situations to hit crossing pedestrians or inabilities to make trivial right turns.
rationale: CPS Validation (Apollo in LGSVL closed loop) and Benchmarks (own scenario generation and KPIs). Secondary: safety.

title: Arbiter: Detecting Interference in LLM Agent System Prompts
evidence_excerpt: Static analysis only. This work analyzes system prompt text, not runtime behavior... a scourer prompt is deliberately vague... combining formal evaluation rules with multi-model LLM scouring to detect interference patterns in system prompts.
rationale: No family: static linting of system prompts, no runtime analysis or scored evaluation.

title: How Clued up are LLMs? Evaluating Multi-Step Deductive Reasoning in a Text-Based Game Environment
evidence_excerpt: we implement a text-based multi-agent version of the classic board game Clue as a rule-based testbed for evaluating multi-step deductive reasoning... We evaluate model performance across five metrics capturing reasoning, reliability, and outcomes.
rationale: Benchmarks: own game-based environment and scoring.

title: CryptoBench: A Dynamic Benchmark for Expert-Level Evaluation of LLM Agents in Cryptocurrency
evidence_excerpt: This paper introduces CryptoBench, the first expert-curated, dynamic benchmark... we employ a sophisticated evaluation protocol centered on an LLM-as-a-Judge framework... scores each agent's final response on a scale of 0 to 3.
rationale: Benchmarks: own dynamically updated CryptoBench.

title: Evaluating Cultural and Social Awareness of LLM Web Agents
evidence_excerpt: We introduce CASA, a benchmark designed to assess LLM agents' sensitivity to cultural and social norms... we propose a comprehensive evaluation framework that measures awareness coverage, helpfulness... and the violation rate when facing misleading web content.
rationale: Benchmarks: own CASA dataset and metrics. Secondary: task success (behavioral).

title: PredictionMarketBench: A SWE-bench-Style Framework for Backtesting Trading Agents on Prediction Markets
evidence_excerpt: We introduce PredictionMarketBench, a SWE-bench-style benchmark for evaluating algorithmic and LLM-based trading agents on prediction markets via deterministic, event-driven replay of historical limit-order-book and trade data... We release four Kalshi-based episodes.
rationale: Benchmarks: own harness, simulator and metrics.

title: Toward Scalable Verifiable Reward: Proxy State-Based Evaluation for Multi-turn Tool-Calling LLM Agents
evidence_excerpt: We propose Proxy State-Based Evaluation, an LLM-driven simulation framework that preserves final state-based evaluation without a deterministic database... Our benchmark contains |Z| = 208 scenarios, partitioned into a training set and a testing set.
rationale: Benchmarks: own benchmark-as-environment for tool-calling agents.

title: WirelessBench: A Tolerance-Aware LLM Agent Benchmark for Wireless Network Intelligence
evidence_excerpt: We present WIRELESSBENCH, the first tolerance-aware, tool-integrated benchmark for LLM-based wireless agents... comprising WCHW (1,392 items), WCNS (1,000 items), and WCMSA (1,000 items), with tolerance-aware scoring and catastrophic-error detection.
rationale: Benchmarks: own three-tier benchmark.

title: Can Compressed LLMs Truly Act? An Empirical Evaluation of Agentic Capabilities in LLM Compression
evidence_excerpt: We introduce the Agent Compression Benchmark (ACBench), the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating how compression impacts LLMs' agentic abilities. ACBench spans (1) 12 tasks across 4 capabilities... and (3) 15 models.
rationale: Benchmarks: own ACBench with new metrics for compression effects.

title: VisualWebArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agents on Realistic Visual Web Tasks
evidence_excerpt: We introduce VisualWebArena, a set of 910 realistic tasks over three diverse web environments: Classifieds, Shopping, and Reddit... we introduce new visually grounded evaluation metrics to the functional evaluation paradigm of WebArena.
rationale: Benchmarks: own self-hosted suite for multimodal web agents.

title: ZeroDayBench: Evaluating LLM Agents on Unseen Zero-Day Vulnerabilities for Cyberdefense
evidence_excerpt: We introduce ZeroDayBench, a benchmark where LLM agents find and patch 22 novel critical vulnerabilities in open-source codebases... We introduce a custom pentest-based evaluation method that scores patches by whether a live exploit is blocked after remediation.
rationale: Benchmarks: own ported vulnerabilities and scoring; pentest checks are scoring, not runtime guards.

title: The Importance of Safety Invariants in Robustness Testing Autonomy Systems
evidence_excerpt: Invariants are used in model checking and runtime verification to verify and validate system safety. Runtime verification techniques exist to check invariants when performing software robustness testing... we mutate field values in messages passed along the system's internal network... Logs recorded during a test can be used to calculate whether an invariant holds during the run of a system.
rationale: Runtime Monitors: invariant checking on replayed trajectories detects safety violations; not a full CPS study.
